description: Add, move, remove or clear a composition's ruler guides (View > Add Guide, Edit Guide, Clear Guides). Positions are pixels from the left (vertical guides) or top (horizontal guides); guides are numbered from 1 in the order they were added

action.description: add a guide, move or remove guide n, or clear all guides

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

guide.description: move, remove: the guide number (1 = first added; add returns it)

name: edit_comp_guides
title: Edit Comp Guides
